title: Biology.
description: Explore living systems from cells to ecosystems. Covering core biological principles required for GCSE Higher and Foundation tiers, including required practicals.

sections.title: Cell Biology
sections.text: Cell structure (animal, plant, bacterial), microscopy, mitosis and the cell cycle, transport in and out of cells, osmosis and active transport.

sections.title: Organisation
sections.text: Tissues, organs and organ systems, digestive system enzymes, circulatory system, heart structure, blood vessels and health.

sections.title: Infection and Response
sections.text: Communicable diseases, pathogens, immune system, vaccination, antibiotics and drug discovery.

sections.title: Bioenergetics
sections.text: Photosynthesis and respiration equations, limiting factors, metabolism and energy transfer.

sections.title: Homeostasis and Response
sections.text: Nervous system, reflex arcs, hormones, menstrual cycle, diabetes, thermoregulation and water balance.

sections.title: Inheritance, Variation and Evolution
sections.text: DNA structure, genes and chromosomes, genetic inheritance, Punnett squares, evolution and natural selection.

sections.title: Ecology
sections.text: Ecosystems, food chains and webs, biodiversity, human impact and trophic levels.

sections.title: Required Practicals
sections.text: Microscopy, food tests, enzyme activity, photosynthesis rate, field investigations and data analysis skills.
